contentCheck.notes: Free-response item (parts a-d) from a scoring-guide page, cataloged as an MCQ with a single stem part. Page 8 shows the absorbance spectrum, (a), (b) and the standard curve; the continuation (page 9) shows (c), (d) and the two-student standard-curve graph. Scoring answers are visible on page 9 but were not used. Classified as one stem part because the catalog has no part list.

primary.evidence: Parts (a), (c) and (d) require choosing the wavelength of maximum absorbance, reading concentration from the standard curve at A = 0.30, and identifying an error that makes the calibration slope less steep.
Part (b) requires M1V1 = M2V2 to find the volume of 0.198 M stock needed for 250.0 mL of 0.0400 M solution.

uncertainty: This is a multi-part FRQ but the catalog gives only a stem part, so per-part concepts are merged; it should be re-typed as an FRQ with parts a-d.
